test_title: PYST 22: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 6 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language, 'RATE' is written as 'UDWH' and 'RICH' is written as 'ULFK'.

How will 'SAVE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a827e903e52c199d8cea030f3655db9b02da63af4503920b2e34c4d18d2c5d.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bea76005a92401523192d195ea57fdc7a7ce71205ab6e5f821f9c3b3eef0a9c.png] 

RATE becomes UDWH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f48ad90b41a932f7d3029ccbbd3681c1bc16f34e48bd253902027552a648afe.png] 

RICH becomes ULFK

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54c1d671e7f3a3521032085dc7f435011ecbc34aa98951c6d5bc018da88953f2.png] 

SAVE becomes VDYH

Hence **the correct answer is VDYH.**
